messages:
maya: quick design review request — Launchpad selector modal. Thinking about compact card grid (3-up) vs single-column list. Want accessibility, clear affordance for keyboard selection, and tighter copy for new users. :eyes:
ashwin: saw the figma — the compact grid looks cleaner on wide screens but the contrast on the card labels feels low. can we bump the label weight or add a subtle bg? link: https://www.figma.com/file/launchpad/selector
luke: +1 on contrast. also worried about keyboard focus ring — hard to tell which card is active when you tab.
samira: nit: the CTA copy currently "Get started" vs "Open project" — for sample projects i think "Open project" sets clearer expectations.
maya: good call on CTA. for first-run flow i'd prefer "Open sample" or "Try sample" so it's explicit it's a sandbox. thoughts?
ashwin: "Try sample" is friendlier. also propose adding a short 1-line description collapsed by default (4–5 words) and expand on hover/focus for details. avoids visual clutter.
luke: regarding keyboard: we need arrow-key nav inside the grid (left/right/up/down) and Enter to select. if we add collapsed summaries, ensure they expand on focus (not just hover).
opsbot: deploy-bot: New build from branch feature/launchpad-selector pushed to staging. :rocket:
maya: accessibility nits: 1) label contrast needs to meet AA (4.5:1) for normal text — can we run a quick ratio check? 2) focus outline should be 3px and use the brand accent but keep high contrast. 3) make the card role="button" with aria-pressed when selected and aria-describedby pointing to the summary paragraph.
ashwin: tried a quick CSS test, snippet: ```css
.card:focus { outline: 3px solid #0B61FF; outline-offset: 2px; }
.card-label { font-weight: 600; color: #142033; }
```
samira: copy idea for the compact label line: "Starter: search assistant" -> then expanded line: "Preconfigured sample project to explore search prompts and routing." Keep expanded text ~50 chars.
luke: mobile behavior note — grid should collapse to 1 column; ensure tap targets remain 44px min.
maya: UX question: should we persist the last-used sample as a quick tile in the console after first run? pros: speedy return. cons: clutter.
ashwin: i'd show a single "Recent sample" in the workspace header — not the full grid. keep it subtle.
samira: accessibility checkbox for the review: keyboard nav, focus state, screen-reader labels, contrast, expand-on-focus, tap target sizes. can we add these to the PR description?
maya: yes please. i'll update the figma with the focus state and add copy variants ("Try sample" / "Open sample"). will drop a small a11y checklist in the PR. :+1:
luke: +1. when you post the PR i'll do a quick keyboard run-through on staging.
maya: thanks all — next steps: ashwin to push contrast update, samira to finalize copy variants, i'll update figma and create the PR with checklist. tagging @luke for keyboard QA when staging is ready. :thumbsup:
